data.message: Cluster diagnostics now run popeye, kubent and trivy in one pass and collect every finding into a single ranked list. Expiring certificates and deprecated API versions are surfaced before they break a rollout.

The Network Policy debugger traces which rule actually allows or denies a connection between two pods. RBAC explorer answers the reverse question: what a given ServiceAccount is permitted to do, and where that permission comes from.
Rightsizing progress is no longer lost when the page reloads — recommendations keep their state across restarts. Pod metrics also stop reporting 0% while a node is under load.
